parameters.query:
-- Insert the enquiry unless this message id was seen before (no duplicate processing).
with ins as (
  insert into enquiries (source, message_id, sender_name, sender_email, sender_phone, subject, body, form_fields, received_at, is_test)
  values ($1, $2, nullif($3, ''), nullif($4, ''), nullif($5, ''), nullif($6, ''), $7, nullif($8, '')::jsonb, $9::timestamptz, $10::boolean)
  on conflict (message_id) do nothing
  returning id
), audit as (
  insert into audit_log (enquiry_id, workflow_execution_id, step, event, detail)
  select id, $11, 'intake', 'received', $12::jsonb from ins
)
select (select id from ins) as enquiry_id,
       (select id from enquiries where message_id = $2) as existing_id;

with upd as (
  update enquiries
     set status = $2, category = nullif($3, ''), urgency = nullif($4, ''), is_suspicious = $5::boolean,
         classification = nullif($6, '')::jsonb
   where id = $1::uuid
  returning id
)
insert into audit_log (enquiry_id, workflow_execution_id, step, event, detail, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, duration_ms)
select id, $7, 'classify', $8, $9::jsonb, $10, $11::int, $12::int, nullif($13, '')::numeric, $14::int from upd
returning enquiry_id;
